question: Under the Government of India PPIUCD programme, a copper IUCD can be inserted up to 48 hours after delivery (immediate postpartum insertion window).

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is true. Immediate PPIUCD insertion is defined as within 48 hours of delivery. The 48-hour window exists because uterine tone and position are favourable. Between 48 hours and 6 weeks, insertion is avoided due to subinvolution risk and high expulsion rates.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The GOI PPIUCD programme defines the immediate insertion window as within 48 hours of delivery (ideally within 10 minutes of placental delivery). Insertion between 48 hours and 4 weeks postpartum is avoided due to the highest expulsion risk; the interval insertion window reopens at 6 weeks.
